records.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
records.claim: Hard-filtering stale facts from LLM memory can lower accuracy when the staleness resolver errs, so deletion should be treated as cost-sensitive.

method_and_setup.method: Controlled sensitivity and paired targeted interventions on a memory filtering step (false-drop vs false-keep), plus a simple deployment-matched gate.
method_and_setup.setup: Three models; a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split.

results.measures: deployment-matched gate vs always hard-drop on the frozen test split
hard-drop accuracy change at the lowest tested resolver reliability

records.change_for_agents: Keep superseded facts (marked, not deleted) unless a validation on matched data shows false-drop risk is low.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Do not delete 'stale' memories on a classifier's say-so in a day-admin agent; default to label-free retention unless you have validated query-critical false-drop risk.

records.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
records.claim: Hallucination-detector rankings do not transfer across small quantized on-device models, and the cheap lexical baseline matches sampling-based detectors.

method_and_setup.method: Reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors (token-margin calibration, lexical n-gram, semantic entropy, SelfCheckGPT-NLI).
method_and_setup.setup: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct at 4-bit NF4 on a single Colab T4, closed-book TriviaQA.

results.measures: cross-model detector ranking agreement
detector AUROC on TriviaQA
AUROC under the TruthfulQA-Generation token-overlap labeler (labeler failure)

records.change_for_agents: Choose the hallucination detector per deployed model and quantization using a small local validation set rather than a published ranking.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If Mitamaton ever gates on-device model output with a hallucination detector, re-validate the choice per model; rankings from 7B-70B models do not transfer to 3B 4-bit.

records.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
records.claim: Multi-agent LLM gains mostly vanish once baselines are matched on sample count or compute.

method_and_setup.method: Meta-analysis with a six-dimension resource vector R, a four-category baseline ladder and multilevel random effects on the log-odds scale.
method_and_setup.setup: Nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations.

results.measures: multi-agent accuracy difference vs baselines matched on sample count or resource budget
share where multi-agent equals or falls below the baseline

records.change_for_agents: Run a same-compute single-agent baseline (sampled, best-of-N) before adopting a multi-agent design.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Before adding sub-agents to the Claude Code / MCP stack, compare against a best-of-N single agent at equal compute; coordination alone rarely pays.

records.title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
records.claim: Generated agent eval suites should be scored per cell and publish coverage, because the mean pass rate can miss or invert real regressions.

method_and_setup.method: Model suite generation as diversity-driven search over requirements x personas x scenario kinds; inject controlled defects and test detection.
method_and_setup.setup: 7 injected defects in a tau^2-bench agent across two domains.

results.measures: kind-diverse suite detecting the orchestration defect

results.value: at or below the detection threshold $θ= 0.10$
results.measures: coverage ceiling for 4 of 5 traceable defects

records.change_for_agents: Publish per-scenario-cell results and coverage alongside the aggregate pass rate for generated agent evals.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If you generate eval suites for an agent, score per cell and report coverage; a single mean pass rate can hide a removed tool.

records.title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
records.claim: Safe agent writes need tool lookups that list or check competing records, and evaluations that vary what tools show.

method_and_setup.method: Presupposition-theory framing plus controlled variation of whether a search lists, counts or omits a second match and whether the user states a refutable claim.
method_and_setup.setup: 36 earlier agents under a role-only prompt, newest Claude and GPT models, and a retail benchmark with an added same-name, same-zip customer.

results.measures: wrong-account writes when a lookup returned the same-name customer first

records.change_for_agents: Return all matching records (or a disambiguating field check) from lookup tools before any destructive or write action.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Make your MCP lookups list or check competing records instead of returning a count or the first hit; a day-admin agent that writes to the wrong contact is the failure.

records.title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
records.claim: A learned interpretable rule monitor with betting-based evidence can decide when to stop or assist an agent run with statistical validity guarantees.

method_and_setup.method: Learn an OR-of-AND monitor by stochastic local search; intervene when a fixed betting statistic crosses a threshold.
method_and_setup.setup: SWE-bench Lite with Ministral 3 8B.

results.measures: token savings from the learned monitor
output precision
empirical false-positive rate

records.change_for_agents: Replace fixed turn limits with a monitor calibrated on past trajectories for a target false-stop rate.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Replaces turn limits and keyword filters in a long-running agent harness with a monitor that has a stated false-stop rate.

records.title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
records.claim: Long-horizon business workflows (200+ steps) can be made reliable without changing the model by externalizing control assets and enforcing them deterministically.

method_and_setup.method: Versioned control assets plus a state machine, acceptance gates and an independent trace auditor; assets updated only after regression check and human approval.
method_and_setup.setup: Three deployed workflows exceeding 200 steps; a 120-case end-to-end set on Domain A.

results.measures: unattended completion on Domain A
end-to-end latency on Domain A
retrieval recall on Domain A

records.change_for_agents: Put workflow definition and acceptance checks in versioned files enforced by a state machine rather than in the prompt.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A concrete case for externalizing workflow state and acceptance gates outside the model, the same direction as skills plus hooks in Claude Code.

records.title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
records.claim: Offloading visual reasoning to callable MLLM tools improves visual fidelity for both text-only and multimodal coding agents.

method_and_setup.method: VHarness: a framework with five atomic actions that wrap general-purpose MLLMs as tools.
method_and_setup.setup: Image-to-HTML, Image-to-SVG and Image-to-3D generation tasks.

records.change_for_agents: Expose a vision model as a tool to a text-only coding agent for screenshot-to-code checks.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Pattern for giving a text-only or local coding model eyes through a tool call instead of switching the whole agent to a multimodal model.

records.title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
records.claim: Agents can obtain the current time but often fail to use it; giving the computed date relation removes the error.

method_and_setup.method: Session-rekindling tasks that fix the earlier conversation and vary only the follow-up date and how temporal information reaches the agent.
method_and_setup.setup: Five model routes and five temporal-information conditions.

records.change_for_agents: Precompute 'event X was N days ago' relations for stored dated records and put them in the context.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly Mitamaton's failure mode: inject the computed relation between stored dates and now into context instead of just the current time.

records.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
records.claim: Governed continual self-training can adapt a production agent to demand drift and harness evolution without regressing accepted behavior.

method_and_setup.method: Reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration, governed reward evolution and governed checkpoint transitions.
method_and_setup.setup: A real production e-commerce agent (Yuancai, B2B procurement) compared with an autonomous post-training baseline.

records.change_for_agents: Gate every model or prompt update on a cumulative set of previously accepted behaviors.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shows the harness (tools, skills, procedures) evolving under a model, and gates updates on a cumulative regression set, a pattern for any self-improving agent loop.

records.title: Aligning AI Teams
records.claim: Diffusion of responsibility explains the single-vs-team safety gap, and a safety lead or a published safety spec restores single-agent alignment behavior.

method_and_setup.method: Mechanism analysis and interventions on multi-agent LLM teams; release of the magelab framework.
method_and_setup.setup: Two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks.

records.change_for_agents: Assign one agent explicit ownership of system-level safety checks and have the coordinator publish a safety spec.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If you run multiple agents, name a safety owner or publish a safety spec from the coordinator; peer critique is not enough.

records.title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
records.claim: Verified hierarchical planning plus runtime enforcement reconciles safety and utility for tool-using LLM agents.

method_and_setup.method: Pre-execution formal verification of a structured plan, then runtime enforcement of specifications using the verified plan.
method_and_setup.setup: Multiple tool-use benchmarks.

results.value: 1.7 times the average task success rate of the best baselines
results.measures: task success versus best baselines

records.change_for_agents: Verify the whole plan against policy before the first tool call and use it to recover when a call is blocked.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Blocking an unsafe tool call leaves an agent stranded; a verified plan gives it a legal way to continue.

records.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
records.claim: Frontier LLM agents struggle to keep their own commitments feasible and to reassess resource allocations over long horizons.

method_and_setup.method: A 200-day business-management simulation benchmark.
method_and_setup.setup: Seven frontier LLMs, 46-product catalog, roughly 1,100 reservation requests.

records.change_for_agents: Persist a commitments ledger and check each new decision against it.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Tests the thing a day-admin agent does: keep its own prior commitments feasible while new requests arrive.

records.title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
records.claim: WebArena-Pro offers the broadest reproducible, multimodal web-agent benchmark, with the best coding-agent harnesses at 62.3%.

method_and_setup.method: Human-validated, LLM-triaged tasks in isolated self-hosted apps with dedicated audio/video extraction actions.
method_and_setup.setup: 300 tasks, 20 web apps, six domain categories.

results.measures: best success rate (Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5)
strongest GenericAgent configurations (Gemini 3.1 Pro omni, Gemma4 31B)

records.change_for_agents: Use a self-hosted, resettable web-app suite for regression-testing browser agents.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A reproducible yardstick that includes Claude Code as a web agent and an open-weight Gemma4 31B datapoint at 30.3%.

records.title: Can Mechanistic Interpretability Help Explain LLM Agent Failures? A Case Study on Web Element Hallucination
records.claim: Probes can predict web-agent action hallucinations but only partially explain them, and results are brittle to prompt format.

method_and_setup.method: Linear probe and activation steering plus circuit analysis.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct interacting with live websites.

results.measures: probe prediction of hallucinated actions before generation
steering along the probe direction

records.change_for_agents: Probe a local agent model's hidden state to flag likely invalid actions before it emits them.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A cheap pre-generation hallucination signal for a local 7B agent, but fragile to how actions are formatted.

records.title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
records.claim: An agentic-RL harness can be learned from task data and evolved with the model instead of hand-written and fixed.

method_and_setup.method: Typed State blocks with learned Compression and Steering programs, verified by execution and replayed over past trajectories.
method_and_setup.setup: CodeSearch in depth, plus ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, models from 1.5B to 8B.

records.change_for_agents: Make context compression and steering rules versioned programs that are tested on replayed trajectories.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Context assembly and steering as evolvable programs is the harness-as-policy idea; relevant if you ever fine-tune a local model.

records.title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
records.claim: A deterministic, layered MCP server can make AI-built apps deployable with independent verification of every fix.

method_and_setup.method: Local MCP server with 50 rules, template, extraction and model-written fix classes, a bounded repair loop and a checker gate.
method_and_setup.setup: 499 real repositories, 23 sample projects, 684 real deployments for the deployability model.

results.measures: deployability model on held-out projects
fixes rejected by independent verification after being reported as applied
gated project deployed, smoke-tested and connected to CI/CD

records.change_for_agents: Verify every agent-reported fix with the same checker that flagged it before accepting it.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A good MCP pattern: deterministic tools do the work and independently verify, the agent only fills the few gaps.

records.title: Time-Consistent Evaluation of Hierarchical Code Graphs for SWE Agents
records.claim: A hierarchical dependency graph as context beats flat AST graphs and no augmentation for localizing post-cutoff pull requests.

method_and_setup.method: ServiceExplorer: deterministic Level-1 package/system and Level-2 module dependency graph, evaluated at four prompt granularities.
method_and_setup.setup: 100 post-T0 pull requests, six foundation models, 7,200 paired evaluations.

results.measures: number of paired evaluations
relative F1 lift

records.change_for_agents: Give a coding agent a two-level package/module dependency map as context before it searches files.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Hierarchical repo maps as context can substitute for a stronger model in Claude Code-style localization.

records.title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
records.claim: Solve rate hides large differences in coding-agent behavior, and behavioral profiles identify the agent stack.

method_and_setup.method: Rule-based parser mapping raw traces to high-level actions, audited against a six-model consensus on 500 events.
method_and_setup.setup: 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models.

results.measures: corpus size

records.change_for_agents: Log search/edit/test action mixes per agent config to see where harness changes shift behavior.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Compare harness settings by behavior, not only pass rate, when tuning a Claude Code setup.

records.title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent
records.claim: A multi-agent system's safety lands near its weakest agent, not its strongest orchestrator.

method_and_setup.method: Plant a forged record in files and compare orchestrators acting alone versus delegating to sub-agents, plus simulations over 18 models.
method_and_setup.setup: Unmodified Claude Code, Codex and a reference harness with their own sub-agent mechanisms.

results.measures: failures when a strong orchestrator delegated to a cheaper sub-agent (largest of four settings)
aggregators repeating a corrupted sub-agent's error

records.change_for_agents: Treat sub-agent outputs as untrusted and verify them against source before the orchestrator acts.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Sub-agent delegation lowers system safety to the weakest reader; audit what cheap sub-agents read and what the orchestrator trusts.

records.title: GraphScent: Calibrating Directional Relevance Signals for Bounded-Context Code Localization
records.claim: Directional relevance asymmetry lets a training-free controller improve stateless code localization for local open-weight models.

method_and_setup.method: GraphScent propagates relation-conditioned log-likelihood ratios over Typed-AST multigraphs, with AST Ripple post-edit co-edit check.
method_and_setup.setup: Gemma 4 models, 211 real-world Python issues in 86 repositories, single consumer GPU.

results.measures: exact localization on lexically hard targets at 31B

records.change_for_agents: Prefer callers and enclosing scopes over callees when assembling bounded context for local code agents.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Fits a local open-weight coding agent: stateless short views plus calibrated likelihood, instead of long multi-turn histories.

records.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
records.claim: A local server can keep interactive latency low while many agents share a model, and pool heterogeneous machines into one endpoint.

method_and_setup.method: Isolated worker processes behind one scheduler with request priority, prompt sharing, durable token logging and fleet routing.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen3.8-27B on Apple M5 Pro; six machines from three chip vendors with 64 simulated users; twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras.

results.measures: first-token time for a chat sent while eight agents are working on Apple M5 Pro
first-token time on llama-server, Ollama and mlx_lm.server
sustained on twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras

records.change_for_agents: Give interactive requests priority over background agent work in any shared local inference server.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly relevant to a Mac-hosted local stack with several agents plus an interactive user; a 27B at typical quantization sits within 64 GB unified memory.

records.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
records.claim: A local one-pass model can offload a large share of agent text-to-SQL queries with no accuracy loss and lower API cost.

method_and_setup.method: Single forward pass predicting slot scores over a bounded grammar, up to 32 candidate plans, a trained validator, and a confidence cascade to the agent.
method_and_setup.setup: BIRD hidden test; 227 post-cutoff questions with Claude Opus 5.5; five SQL dialects zero-shot.

results.measures: LuthorSQL alone on BIRD's hidden test set
cascade with Claude Opus 5.5 at the same accuracy

records.change_for_agents: Route queries through a small local model first and escalate only when its confidence is low.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A cascade template: a small local model handles easy calls and escalates uncertain ones to a hosted agent. Its 9 GB footprint fits easily in 64 GB.

records.title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
records.claim: A learned, source-linked context manager beats summarization, pruning and history selection on long-horizon tool tasks.

method_and_setup.method: Compact execution state plus source-linked evidence, learned selector and adaptive retention; new metrics S_alpha and normalized cost per success.
method_and_setup.setup: AppWorld, OfficeBench and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors.

results.measures: CarryOn average over the three benchmarks

records.change_for_agents: Keep a compact state plus pointers to original evidence rather than rewriting history into a summary.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Source-linked evidence plus compact state is a middle path between summaries that lose details and full histories.

records.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
records.claim: Semantic-similarity-based secure aggregation defends multi-agent systems against optimized malicious responses.

method_and_setup.method: Optimization-based attack with a surrogate multi-agent system; SecMAS aggregation by semantic similarity.
method_and_setup.setup: Evaluations against existing aggregation rules, untargeted and targeted attacks, adaptive variants.

records.change_for_agents: Aggregate sub-agent answers by agreement of a large consistent subset rather than trusting any single response.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If you aggregate several agents' answers, majority-style rules can be attacked by one malicious agent; semantic-consistency aggregation is a cheap defence.

records.title: Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation
records.claim: LLM verifier judgments are unstable when execution evidence crosses abstraction boundaries, and restoring provenance recovers most failures.

method_and_setup.method: Construct matched native, abstracted and restored views of frozen executions, holding task, trajectory, outcome and verifier fixed.
method_and_setup.setup: Four agent-evaluation benchmarks, seven verifier backbones, four verification protocols, three abstraction boundaries.

results.measures: transport failure under macro abstraction and delegation
transport failures recovered by restoring execution provenance

records.change_for_agents: Pass execution provenance, not just the compacted summary, to LLM verifiers.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If your harness compacts history or delegates, an LLM judge sees less; keep provenance available to the verifier.

records.title: MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading
records.claim: A progress-bounded local retrieval assistant prevents spoiler leakage while mid-sized local models match larger ones.

method_and_setup.method: Hybrid retrieval (vector similarity, BM25, summary embeddings) restricted to the reader's current position.
method_and_setup.setup: Classical English books; quantitative comprehension metrics and LLM judging; local models from 2b to 5b+.

records.change_for_agents: Scope retrieval for an on-device assistant by a boundary (position, permission) before ranking.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A position-bounded retrieval pattern: scope what a local assistant may see to what the user has reached, relevant to privacy-scoped on-device agents.
